title: Parlay losses, what I found: 20 settled parlays are -$63.42, the buyer won 19. 13 of those 20 are ONE linked block (the Texans in six parlays plus linked favourites), so it is about 8 independent bets, all heavy favourites, at only +0.5 to 1 point over our price: the margin could not pay for one bad cluster. 'Identical bets' is real: the Magic + Thunder pair was filled twice in 7 minutes. Fix built and tested: the same parlay is never held or quoted twice, and one outcome sits in at most two open parlays. It goes live at ~18:31 UTC with one engine reset (the job restarted at 17:30 without it). Today's fills are priced at +0.1 point, worth about 4 cents each in expectation, so profit will come from the classes the graded study found positive for makers (two legs priced .15-.45, longshot legs, in-play same-game pairs) and from more independent bets, not from margin.
